notes.title: The Steam Summer Sale is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43813655/222d04365fdb9a268857ff55c87df4a9c924dde8.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

The [b]Steam Summer Sale has started[/b] and will last until July 10th! I am happy to share that [u][b]you can purchase my games with discounts never seen before[/b][/u]! This is the perfect opportunity to give them a try and have fun this summer!

[list]
[*] [b]Comet Force at -35%[/b]
[*] [b]Destroy The Monoliths at -50%[/b]
[*] [b]Skycliffs at -70%[/b]
[/list]

Also, I would like to highlight that the demo of my upcoming game, My Tiny Landscape, is still available and just got an update. Don't hesitate to give it a shot, wishlist, and share your feedback!

I wish you all a great summer, and I'll see you next time!

[i]-Radiant Sloth[/i]
